eligible.label: Conjecture 6.1
eligible.statement_transcription: Each bridgeless graph admits a 2-flow phi_2 and a 4-flow phi_4 such that for any edge e, if phi_2(e)=0, then |phi_4(e)|>=2.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as a conjecture in the source's open-problem collection; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Problem 2.1
eligible.statement_transcription: Let G be a random 4-regular graph. Is it true that the coefficient of P_G at product_{v in V(G)} v^2 is a.a.s. non-zero?
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: The surrounding text calls the motivating property an open question, and the claim is printed as Problem 2.1; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Problem 5.1
eligible.statement_transcription: If a cubic graph admits a 2-homogeneous coloring, then 4 colors are always sufficient.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Introduced as one of two proposed conjectures and printed as Problem 5.1; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Problem 5.2
eligible.statement_transcription: There is a finite number of connected bridgeless cubic graphs that do not admit a 2-homogeneous coloring.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Introduced as one of two proposed conjectures and printed as Problem 5.2; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Problem 7.1
eligible.statement_transcription: Every bicritical snark is almost-Z_2^2-connected and almost-Z_4-connected.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: The source explicitly introduces it as a proposed open problem and reports only checks on small examples; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 16 (Type-2 constant of Tensors)
eligible.statement_transcription: For p>=2, E||sum_i g_i T_i||_{I_p} <= O-tilde_{r,p}(d^(1/2-1/p) sqrt(sum_i ||T_i||_{I_p}^2)); the hidden factors are constants depending on r,p and polylogarithmic factors in d,n.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as Conjecture 16 in a source that explicitly records open problems; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 17
eligible.statement_transcription: Let G be distributed as G(n,1/2). Then E theta(G)=(1+o(1)) sqrt(n).
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Immediately before the conjecture, the source says the precise asymptotics for G(n,1/2) is still open; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 18
eligible.statement_transcription: Let G be distributed as a random dense circulant graph. Then E theta(G)=(1+o(1)) sqrt(n).
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as Conjecture 18 and followed by a stated partial result; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 19
eligible.statement_transcription: Let N=4M-5 and draw A in C^(N x M) with im(A) uniform on the Grassmannian of M-dimensional subspaces of C^(4M-5). If p_M is the probability that x mod T maps injectively to |Ax|^2, then (a) p_M<1 for every M and (b) lim_{M to infinity} p_M=0.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: The source says this refined conjecture still remains open and prints it as Conjecture 19; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 22
eligible.statement_transcription: Let MUB(d) denote the largest possible number of simultaneously mutually unbiased bases in C^d. We have MUB(6)<7.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: The source says non-prime-power dimensions remain open and dimension six is the smallest open instance; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 24 (Zauner's Conjecture)
eligible.statement_transcription: For each dimension d, there exists an ETF in C^d with n=d^2 vectors.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: The source says an unconditional proof remains unavailable and prints the claim as Conjecture 24; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 25
eligible.statement_transcription: For prime p congruent to 1 mod 4, the clique number of the Paley graph satisfies omega(G_p)=O(polylog(p)).
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Called a well-known conjecture and printed as Conjecture 25; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 26
eligible.statement_transcription: theta(complement(G_{p,1})) is asymptotic to sqrt(p/2), for prime p congruent to 1 mod 4, where G_{p,1} is the 1-localization of the Paley graph.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as Conjecture 26 after stating this was empirically observed; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 27
eligible.statement_transcription: For all sufficiently large primes p congruent to 1 mod 4, theta(complement(G_{p,2})) <= (2/3)sqrt(p), where G_{p,2} is the 2-localization of the Paley graph.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as Conjecture 27 after a discussion of empirical evidence; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 28
eligible.statement_transcription: There exists epsilon>0 such that the degree-4 Sum-of-Squares relaxation for the clique number of the Paley graph gives a bound O(p^(1/2-epsilon)).
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as Conjecture 28; surrounding text reports only numerical evidence and a lower bound; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 29
eligible.statement_transcription: There exists epsilon>0 such that, for m asymptotic to p^(1/2+epsilon), every matrix made from m distinct vectors of the Paley ETF has condition number bounded by a constant independent of p.
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as Conjecture 29 and identified as the Paley ETF conjecture; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.

eligible.label: Conjecture 30 (KLS Conjecture)
eligible.statement_transcription: Equivalently: there is a universal C>0 such that every log-concave measure mu with covariance A satisfies psi_mu >= C/sqrt(||A||_op).
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as Conjecture 30; the equivalent covariance formulation is internally unambiguous; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.
eligible.transcription_note: Use the explicitly stated equivalent covariance formulation because the first displayed formulation has an H/S variable typo.

eligible.label: Conjecture 31 (Sharp graph matrix bounds)
eligible.statement_transcription: There are functions f and g depending only on fixed shape alpha such that E||M_alpha|| = Theta(n^(f(alpha)) (log n)^(g(alpha))).
eligible.current_open_status_evidence: Printed as Conjecture 31 after explaining that existing inequalities fail to give sharp bounds for some shapes; no later source version or exact-claim resolution located through the cutoff.
